The provisions of this schedule shall not operate to decrease the base salary biweekly rate of employees employed on the effective date of the amending act codified in this section. Furthermore, the base salary biweekly rate of such employees shall not be increased beyond the rate in effect on the effective date of the amending act codified in this section.

Source: PL 7-121 § 2.
